name: Rodeo Drive / Special Events / Holiday Program Committee Liaison Meeting Agenda
minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  Video Teleconference
  The Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / Rodeo Drive/Special Events/Holiday
  Program Committee Meeting

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Thursday, September 26, 2024
  10:30 AM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  September 26, 2024 / 10:30 AM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Lester Friedman, Councilmember Mary Wells, Assistant City
  Manager Keith Sterling, Public Information Manager Lauren Santillana,
  Special Events Film Coordinator Patricia Betancourt

  1) Public Comment:

  None

  2) Request from Dick Clark Productions and The Beverly Hills Hotel for Approval of
  Street and Sidewalk Closures Associated with the Golden Globe Awards Ceremony
  Scheduled for Sunday, January 5, 2025:
  a. Presentation by Patricia Betancourt:
  i. The Golden Globes will take place at the Beverly Hilton Hotel on Sunday,
  January 5, 2025.
  ii. Partial westbound closures on Santa Monica will begin on December 30,
  2024, and end January 8. Full westbound closures will begin January 3 and
  end January 6 while full eastbound closures on Santa Monica will occur
  from January 4 to January 6.
  iii. Wilshire eastbound curb lane closures will run from December 30 to
  January 8 while the full closure of eastbound traffic will run from January 3
  to January 6. Westbound traffic will be reduced from January 4 to January
  6.
  iv. Dick Clark Productions is requesting a fee waiver which would either be a
  reduction of some of the billable components withing the larger permits or
  a flat 15% reduction of both the Special Event and Filming Permits.
  b. The full closures of eastbound and reduction of westbound traffic on Wilshire will
  end at 5 AM on Monday, January 6 and so will not impact El Rodeo Traffic.
  c. The City EOC will be activated during the Golden Globes and the mobile command
  post will be located on Whittier.
  d. BHPD will be working closely with the FBI to ensure the security of the event.
  e. Letter notifications for the street closures last year were sent to every residence in
  a two-mile radius of the closures two weeks before the event. This included people
  living in Los Angeles.
 Highlights for September 26, 2024
Rodeo Drive/Special Events/Holiday Program Committee

  f. Mayor Friedman and Councilmember Wells are against the fee reductions.
  g. Both Liaisons are in favor of the proposed road closures.
  h. The Liaisons are also in favor of continuing the letter notification program from last
  year.

  3) Adjournment:
  Date / Time: September 26, 2024 / 10:59 PM
